subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card-action callbacks use when action.value.command/text is present alongside form_value, input_value, option, options, or name?
rationale: The field-loss root cause is source-proven, but choosing JSON passthrough versus preserving command dispatch with attached metadata affects existing Feishu card workflows and plugin-facing behavior.

options.title: Preserve commands plus metadata
options.body: Keep existing command/text dispatch for callbacks that provide action.value.command/text, while adding a documented way to surface form/select metadata to the agent.

options.title: Adopt JSON payloads for rich callbacks
options.body: Intentionally switch rich form/select callbacks to structured JSON text and document that command-style handlers must parse that payload.

options.title: Limit the first fix
options.body: Ship only a narrower form_value/input_value passthrough once parser coverage and live proof are present, then defer select/options contract work.

recommendation.title: Preserve commands plus metadata
recommendation.body: Keep existing command/text dispatch for callbacks that provide action.value.command/text, while adding a documented way to surface form/select metadata to the agent.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact, so this is the best available owner for the channel payload contract.
